method: the cold-preview gate composes the product, runs real work (Process A), then in Process B calls the read-only attributed Preview; the canonical Work store, the durable association store and the DSH session source are all read-only during the Preview
invariants: building the Preview appends no Work event
building the Preview mutates no ProjectIR
building the Preview changes no Promotion
building the Preview appends no association observation
building the Preview resumes no DSH Session
building the Preview modifies no DSH Session Persistence
note: read-only means no authority-bearing effects or source mutations; opening a local read handle is permitted and does not mutate the source (H1 established this for the reader and P2-C preserves it)
